Boroughs, District Municipal, Primary Education and Local Fund Audit Acts. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 29th October, 2024 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993. 
No. KP/40 of 2024/PRHRDD/GRT/e-file/14/2023/5975/Section-G: WHEREAS, certain draft rules, were published 
as required by sub-section (5) of section 274 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj. 18 of 1993), at pages 17-1 to 
17-2 in the Gujarat Government Gazette, Extraordinary, Part I-A, Central Section, dated the 1st July, 2024  under the 
Government Notification, Panchayats, Rural Housing and Rural Development Department No. KP/17 of 2024/ 
PRHRDD/GRT/e-file/14/2023/5975/Section-G, dated the 1st July, 2024, inviting objections or suggestions from all 
persons likely to be affected thereby before the expiry of thirty days from the date of publication of the said notification 
in the Official Gazette; 
AND WHEREAS, no objection or suggestion has been received by the Government in respect to the said 
Draft Notification; 
NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 274 read with sub- section (3) of section 
51 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj. 18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat hereby makes the following 
rules, further to amend the Gujarat Village Panchayats Election of Sarpanch (Manner of Allotment of Reserved Offices 
of Sarpanch by Rotation) Rules, 1994, namely:-

AND WHEREAS, no objection or suggestion has been received by the Government in respect to the said

NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 274 read with sub- section (3) of section

blocks.text:
Government Central Press, Gandhinagar.
193-2 
GUJARAT GOVERNMENT GAZETTE, EX., 29-10-2024 
 [ PART  I-A 
1. (1)  These rules may be called the Gujarat Village Panchayats Election of Sarpanch (Manner of Allotment of 
Reserved Offices of Sarpanch by Rotation) (Amendment) Rules, 2024. 
 
(2) They shall come into force from the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. In the Gujarat Village Panchayats Election of Sarpanch (Manner of Allotment of Reserved Offices of Sarpanch by 
Rotation) Rules, 1994, in rule 4, in sub-rule (3), for the words "ten percent of the total number of offices of 
sarpanch of village panchayats in a taluka", the words, brackets and figures "twenty-seven per cent. of the total 
number of offices of sarpanch of village panchayats in a taluka subject to the provisos to clause (a) of sub-section 
(2) of section 51 of the Act." shall be substituted. 
 
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat, 
SIMRAN POPTANI, 
Deputy Secretary to Government. 
---------- 
Signed by:BHOLUSINGH G THAKUR
Date: 2024.10.29 20:57:54 +05:30
Reason: Validate Document
Location: Government Central Press,
Gandhinagar
Signature Not Verified
